Care Coordinator carries the only real exposure, through scheduling and matching software.

Nursing is the qualification route upward and requires starting a degree.

India's population is ageing, households are smaller, and adult children increasingly live in other cities or countries. The need for paid care at home grows directly from all three and none of them reverses. || [licensing_body] Null, and it is a serious gap. It also belongs beside Nurse and Emergency Medical Technician psychometrically rather than beside Beautician and Tattoo Artist. DECISIONS.md 2.06 had assigned this base layer to Sector 4 all along.
